facades.look: a long wall of two houses on the west side of Palmotićeva ulica, south of the crossing with Ulica Milana Amruša. LEFT part (about two thirds of the width): a tall white and pale-grey neo-renaissance palace with a rusticated ground floor of rough stone blocks with tall round-arched windows behind white-painted bars (the rightmost arch is a tall arched door with dark green bars), above it a plain smooth floor of rectangular windows, then two floors of tall arched windows with carved cartouches over them on the first upper floor and a heavy cornice. RIGHT part (about one third): a lower house in weathered dark brown-grey plaster, five bays: rusticated ground floor with round-arched windows in hoods, at the far left a boarded-up door with a small blue house-number plate, a string course, first floor with tall windows under triangular hoods on brackets with sills, second floor with small square windows in a row and a plain plaster cornice. No text on either house. Copy exactly.
